name: nyumbani/essentials
description: Opinionated, headless helpers, services, packages, and AI skills and rules that define how every Nyumbani internal app is structured. The look is the separate nyumbani/ui package.

suggest.nyumbani/ui: The Nyumbani look: layouts, sign-in and error pages, the modal and the theme, chosen in php artisan nyumbani:install
suggest.nyumbani/daraja: M-Pesa payments through Safaricom Daraja, chosen in php artisan nyumbani:install
suggest.nyumbani/messaging: SMS sent through Nyumbani Connect, chosen in php artisan nyumbani:install
suggest.nyumbani/dt-tables: Searchable, sortable data tables, chosen in php artisan nyumbani:install
suggest.nyumbani/docs: The local-only guides of Nyumbani packages, chosen in php artisan nyumbani:install and installed with composer require --dev nyumbani/docs
